scenes.caption: Skin Smoothing Cream
scenes.say: Want a moisturizer that keeps skin hydrated all day and night? This is the Dermalogica Skin Smoothing Cream.

scenes.caption: 48-hour hydration
scenes.say: It gives forty-eight hours of continuous hydration, powered by Active HydraMesh Technology.

scenes.caption: Hyaluronic Acid Complex
scenes.say: Inside is a Hyaluronic Acid Complex with mallow, cucumber and arnica, plus grape seed extract and vitamins C and E.

scenes.caption: Rich, not greasy
scenes.say: The texture is rich and creamy, and it smooths skin without a greasy finish.

scenes.caption: Morning and night
scenes.say: After cleansing and toning, apply it over your face and throat in light, upward strokes, morning and night. The link is in the description.

items.title: Dermalogica PreCleanse Review: Cleansing Oil for Acne-Prone Skin, How to Use It
items.lead: Dermalogica PreCleanse: a deep-cleansing oil that melts away excess oil, sunscreen and makeup, recommended for all skin types, including acne-prone skin and skin with visible pores.
items.hook: The Dermalogica PreCleanse: what it does and how to use it.
facts: Deep-cleansing oil that melts impurities and makeup from skin; the first step of the Double Cleanse
Removes excess sebum, sunscreen, waterproof makeup and pollutants without clogging pores
Borage seed, kukui, apricot, rice bran and vitamin E oils condition the skin
Recommended for all skin types, including acne-prone skin and skin with visible pores
Massage over dry face with dry hands, add water to emulsify, rinse, then follow with your cleanser

scenes.caption: PreCleanse
scenes.say: Can a cleansing oil work for acne-prone skin? This is the Dermalogica PreCleanse. In this review, we cover what it is, who it is for, and exactly how to use it.

scenes.caption: Deep-cleansing oil
scenes.say: PreCleanse is a deep-cleansing oil that melts impurities and makeup from the skin.

scenes.caption: Step one: Double Cleanse
scenes.say: It is the first step of the Double Cleanse. You use it before your regular cleanser, so that cleanser can work on clean skin.

scenes.caption: Sunscreen and makeup
scenes.say: It melts away excess oil, sunscreen and even waterproof makeup.

scenes.caption: Pollutants and leftovers
scenes.say: It also lifts away pollutants and leftover products from your day.

scenes.caption: Won't clog pores
scenes.say: And it removes oils without clogging pores.

scenes.caption: Five conditioning oils
scenes.say: The formula is a blend of borage seed, kukui, apricot, rice bran and vitamin E oils, which condition the skin.

scenes.caption: All skin types
scenes.say: It is recommended for all skin types, including acne-prone skin and skin with visible pores.

scenes.caption: Oily skin too
scenes.say: Yes, that includes oily skin. Oil helps dissolve oil, so excess sebum comes away with it.

scenes.caption: Dry hands, dry face
scenes.say: Here is how to use it. Pump it into dry hands and massage it over a dry face.

scenes.caption: Focus on congestion
scenes.say: Spend extra time on areas of congestion, like the nose and chin.

scenes.caption: Add water
scenes.say: Then wet your hands and keep massaging. The oil turns into a light, milky emulsion.

scenes.caption: Rinse and cleanse
scenes.say: Rinse with lukewarm water, then follow with your Dermalogica cleanser to finish the Double Cleanse.

scenes.caption: PreCleanse recap
scenes.say: That is the Dermalogica PreCleanse: a deep-cleansing oil for all skin types, including acne-prone skin. The link is in the description.

items.title: How to Use Dermalogica Calm Water Gel (Dual Hyaluronic Acid) for Dry, Sensitive Skin #shorts
items.lead: Dermalogica Calm Water Gel: a weightless water-gel moisturizer with dual hyaluronic acid for dry, sensitive skin.
items.hook: The Dermalogica Calm Water Gel: what it does and how to use it.
facts: Dual hyaluronic acid: sodium hyaluronate and hydrolyzed sodium hyaluronate
Works in different skin surface layers to increase and lock in moisture
Weightless water-gel that transforms into a skin-quenching fluid
For dry, sensitive skin; no artificial colors or fragrances (50 ml)

scenes.caption: Calm Water Gel
scenes.say: Dry, sensitive skin that hates heavy creams? This is the Dermalogica Calm Water Gel, a weightless water-gel moisturizer.

scenes.caption: Dual hyaluronic acid
scenes.say: It is made with dual hyaluronic acid: sodium hyaluronate, and hydrolyzed sodium hyaluronate.

scenes.caption: Locks in moisture
scenes.say: The two forms work in different layers of the skin surface, to increase moisture and lock it in.

scenes.caption: Water-gel texture
scenes.say: As you smooth it on, the water-gel transforms into a skin-quenching fluid.

scenes.caption: No added fragrance
scenes.say: It has no artificial colors or fragrances, and it comes in a fifty milliliter jar. The link is in the description.
